subject: Privdeploy stewardship & evidence cadence — MSA/Order Form addendum
messages:
From: Kevin Sullivan <kevin.sullivan@elarahealth.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-28T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: On-prem evidence & stewardship for MSA addendum

Hi Grace/Marissa/Karthik,

Thanks again for the call this morning. As we formalize the MSA addendum and Order Form language for the on-prem (VPC + local operator) deployment, legal here needs a short, executable evidence plan and a named operations steward from Redwood who will be our point of contact for audits and attestation windows.

Specifically we need:
- A single designated steward for operator access and evidence hunt (name, title, contact).
- A cadence for delivery of SOC2 artifacts / snapshot manifests (we'd prefer quarterly, but open to weekly snapshot manifests for the first 2 quarters).
- A runbook or short playbook describing how operator witness or remote session for forensic snapshot verification would be scheduled and executed.
- Confirmation on license scope language (territory and derivative rights): we will circulate a marked-up Order Form and need Redwood's legal to confirm any carveouts.

I've attached a short evidence checklist (Elara_evidence_request.xlsx) to capture fields we typically expect. Can you propose the steward and a draft cadence by EOD Tuesday?

Appreciate it —
Kevin Sullivan
Senior Counsel, Elara Health
legal@elarahealth.com

Attachment: Elara_evidence_request.xlsx
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Kevin Sullivan <kevin.sullivan@elarahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-28T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: On-prem evidence & stewardship for MSA addendum

Kevin —

Thanks for the checklist and clear asks. We can do this. Proposed plan below and attached a short draft runbook for your review (privdeploy-runbook-draft.docx).

Designated steward:
- Karthik Iyer, Senior Solutions Engineer (karthik_iyer@redwood.com) — primary for operator coordination and evidence deliveries. He will own scheduling witness windows and acting as the operator liaison.

Evidence cadence (proposal):
- Weeks 0–8 (onboarding): weekly snapshot manifest deliveries plus a one-time remote witness session.
- Ongoing: quarterly snapshot manifests (JSON manifests + hash summary) with a 5 business-day SLA for follow-up artifacts requested during a window.
- Escalation: any forensic request that requires on-site witness will be scoped as a paid addendum (we'll include an optional Exhibit in the Order Form).

Runbook summary (attached):
- Who: steward contact details, escalation path, legal notice to schedule.
- What: manifest contents, hash checking procedure, minimal operator commands to produce snapshot.
- When: typical windows (PT business hours) and a 30-day advance scheduling option for on-site witness.
- How: remote session steps, screenshots, and an agreed evidence binder format.

Open items for legal:
1) Marissa, can your team confirm whether Redwood can accept a quarterly manifest cadence as the baseline or whether the Order Form must codify weekly snapshots for a specific probationary period?
2) Kevin, we added a short Exhibit that defines evidence deliverables and any costed witness option. Is that acceptable?

Thanks — happy to jump on a 30-min sync if useful.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Head of Customer Solutions — Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.com

Attachment: privdeploy-runbook-draft.docx
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Kevin Sullivan <kevin.sullivan@elarahealth.com>
Date: 2026-06-29T08:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: On-prem evidence & stewardship for MSA addendum

Looping in a quick legal note. See attached redlines for the MSA and Order Form (redlines_msa_orderform_v3.pdf). Key items to be aware of:

- License scope: we preserved the standard territory and usage language but removed an unnecessary blanket derivative-rights grant in §3.2 — Elara, please confirm whether you need that for internal analytics workflows.
- Operator access: proposed carveout limits operator shell access to a documented, timeboxed session executed under customer supervision; we cannot accept unrestricted operator residency.
- Evidence exhibit: we've drafted an Exhibit that defines manifest structure and optional witness terms. The Exhibit includes a clause that windowed on-site witness is a billable service (Order Form line item).

Kevin — if you can review the redlines and confirm anything that is a hard requirement we can negotiate exceptions. Otherwise, the stewarding plan Grace suggested (Karthik as primary) looks good to us.

Quick ask: please confirm whether Elara needs the initial weekly snapshots to be delivered by your procurement signature date or whether you can accept them on a 30-day onboarding window after signature. That affects our sprint to produce the initial manifests.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Director, Contracts & Commercial Ops — Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Attachment: redlines_msa_orderform_v3.pdf

Grace/Marissa/Karthik —

Thanks — this is helpful and appreciated. Elara can accept the steward designation of Karthik Iyer. A few clarifications from legal/procurement:

- Weekly snapshots for onboarding are acceptable; procurement requests the initial 30 days to align with internal change windows. We can therefore accept weekly manifests starting at signature + 30 days.
- The derivative-rights language is negotiable: we do need a limited internal analytics carve (non-commercial), we'll mark that and share a short counter-mark on the PDF.
- Exhibit approach + billable witness line item works for us. Please send the final Exhibit with Order Form line items and we will circulate a DocuSign request.

Next steps:
1) Grace / Marissa — incorporate the agreed cadence (signature + 30 days onboarding for weekly snapshots) into the Exhibit and send final PDF.
2) We will prepare a DocuSign envelope once we have the final Exhibit and Order Form numbers.
3) Karthik — once signature is out, we'll coordinate a kickoff to schedule the first remote witness session.

Kevin Sullivan
Senior Counsel, Elara Health
legal@elarahealth.com
